tasks.short: Assess post-date pregnancy and determine interventions

steps.what: Review the actual pregnancy dates, history and available assessment results
inputs: existing patient pregnancy record and actual prior results
outputs: reviewed pregnancy context and information gaps

steps.what: Assess the actual status of the post-date pregnancy with the patient
inputs: reviewed pregnancy context and information gaps
patient's actual symptoms and examination/test findings
outputs: actual assessment findings and clinical uncertainties

steps.what: Determine appropriate treatments, interventions or escalation from the actual assessment
inputs: actual assessment findings and clinical uncertainties
current applicable clinical protocol
patient's preferences and questions
outputs: midwife-determined plan and unresolved or escalated concerns

steps.what: Record actual assessment findings, clinical reasoning and the midwife-determined plan
inputs: actual assessment findings and clinical uncertainties
midwife-determined plan and unresolved or escalated concerns

loop.purpose: Draft the clinical note from midwife-dictated actuals
loop.input: midwife's actual dictated findings, reasoning, plan and explicit uncertainties
loop.output: proposed structured assessment note with unsupported fields left blank
loop.check: Midwife checks actual observations, negation, dates, attribution, clinical reasoning and preservation of the chosen plan; model cannot add a diagnosis or intervention
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual note
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields come first; organising free-text dictated reasoning without changing meaning requires semantic drafting

steps.what: Read and approve the complete final post-date assessment note against actual findings
inputs: complete proposed post-date assessment note
actual assessment findings and midwife-determined plan

steps.what: Save the approved assessment note in the same clinical record system
inputs: approved final post-date assessment note

tasks.design: Retain pregnancy assessment and intervention decisions with the midwife at {OTHER}, the care setting and clinical record system. Try approved native note drafting from the midwife's own actual dictation, then check the completed note before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: The pregnancy record and planned appointments do not establish current clinical status.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded note drafting can organise actual clinician-dictated findings without choosing care.
tasks.still_hard: Assess current pregnancy status and determine the appropriate clinical response.
tasks.human_edge: Examine, listen and make an accountable care decision with the patient.

ambition.what: Support existing documentation without changing clinical decision rights.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6; verify approved clinical processing, data access and consultation requirements

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved clinical documentation tools can organise clinician-dictated actual findings into a draft for clinician review.

assumptions: OTHER means the clinical record and physical care setting. Existing clinical record owners supply actual dated history and test results; s1 reads them, s2 obtains actual current findings, and s3 makes the clinical plan. No model assesses pregnancy status or selects an intervention.

s4 includes the midwife dictating actual encounter/date, findings, reasoning, chosen plan and unresolved concerns, plus correcting the proposed note; its retained 65% includes all that capture. Physical findings are not inferred from patient speech or the appointment plan. Missing findings remain blank for manual completion.

Native structured notes and approved dictation/drafting come first. Central is conditional on typing-heavy narrative documentation still occurring today; final whole-note review remains fully counted at s5. If native notes already suffice or approved drafting is unavailable, no change is made and saving is zero.

The final note exists before s5 approval; edits void approval. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Treatment implementation, prescriptions and referral sends are not performed by this documentation design and require their own clinical workflow. Provisional B=100, R=93, gross=7; incremental focal template/error upkeep=1; net=6. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Approved clinical drafting availability and actual correction time.
research_questions: Compare full documentation time including dictation, corrections and final source/meaning review without shortening assessment.

already_counted.description: Final whole-note review retained in s5

incremental.description: Inspect clinical note drafting errors and maintain approved template fields

approvals.approved_version: complete final post-date assessment note and midwife-determined plan

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where approved drafting is unavailable or current notes already suffice; high allows three extra hours correcting clinical narrative meaning beyond central net 6.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set up and monitor oxygen or medications

steps.what: Verify the patient, current oxygen or medication order and relevant clinical observations
inputs: actual patient identity and current authorised order
actual clinical observations and medication record
outputs: verified patient/order context and unresolved concerns

steps.what: Set up oxygen equipment or medication administration according to the verified order
inputs: verified patient/order context and unresolved concerns
actual oxygen or medication equipment and supplies

steps.what: Monitor actual oxygen or medication administration and the patient's response
inputs: checked administration setup
actual administration and patient response
outputs: actual administration observations, response and clinical actions

steps.what: Enter actual administration times, observed values, response and actions in the clinical record
inputs: actual administration observations, response and clinical actions
verified patient/order context

steps.what: Review and approve the completed administration record against actual events
inputs: complete actual administration record
actual administration observations, response and clinical actions

steps.what: Commit the approved administration record in the same clinical system
inputs: approved final administration record

tasks.design: Retain setup, monitoring and response decisions with the midwife at {OTHER}, the bedside equipment and clinical record. Use existing structured administration fields, with explicit actual-event entry and a final record check before commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: An order or equipment setting does not prove actual administration or patient response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical record fields support capture but establish no additional reduction in actual checks.
tasks.still_hard: Recognise a changing patient response and act appropriately.
tasks.human_edge: Attend to the patient while verifying what actually occurred.

ambition.what: Retain existing administration monitoring and documentation controls.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical administration records distinguish authorised orders from actual administration events and observed patient response.

assumptions: Existing authorised clinician supplies patient/order ID and prescribed setup instructions; the midwife verifies them in s1. The midwife supplies actual administration time, delivered/observed values with units, patient response and actions from s3 and records them in s4. No planned dose or pump setting substitutes for actual events.

Native patient/order defaults and structured administration entry are considered. They already provide the identifier context; no duplicate typing, absent device interface or extra transcription baseline is invented. Drafting a narrative cannot remove direct checks or the actual fields, so no additional saving is established.

Physical setup and ongoing monitoring remain full time. Existing device runtime is not focal human effort. s5 follows the completed record before s6 commit; changes invalidate approval. Same-system commit is approximately zero time and carries no saving.
Provisional B=100, R=100, gross=0; incremental=0; net=0. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Any demonstrable separate administrative repetition in the local administration record.
research_questions: Observe actual-event capture separately from bedside monitoring before considering a documentation change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported reduction after separating actual record entry, final review and commit from setup and monitoring.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Perform regular postpartum mother and baby assessments

steps.what: Review actual mother/baby history, prior findings and the required assessment interval
inputs: existing actual maternal and newborn records
current care plan and assessment schedule

steps.what: Perform the mother's actual postpartum health assessment
inputs: reviewed postpartum assessment context
mother's actual symptoms, answers and examination findings

steps.what: Perform the baby's actual postpartum health assessment
inputs: reviewed postpartum assessment context
baby's actual observations and examination findings

steps.what: Interpret maternal and newborn findings and determine follow-up or escalation
inputs: actual maternal assessment findings
actual newborn assessment findings
current applicable clinical protocol
outputs: midwife-determined maternal/newborn follow-up and unresolved concerns

steps.what: Record actual postpartum findings and chosen follow-up in the correct mother and baby records
inputs: actual maternal assessment findings
actual newborn assessment findings
midwife-determined maternal/newborn follow-up and unresolved concerns
outputs: complete proposed maternal and newborn assessment notes

loop.purpose: Draft separate source-grounded postpartum assessment notes
loop.input: midwife-dictated actual maternal/newborn findings and chosen follow-up, with patient identifiers
loop.output: separate proposed notes with absent fields blank
loop.check: Midwife checks patient attribution, dates, values/units, negation, clinical meaning and exact chosen follow-up; observations cannot be copied between mother and baby
loop.stop: One draft and one correction, then manual notes
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fields handle identifiers; organising actual free-text findings and reasoning requires semantic drafting

steps.what: Read and approve the completed maternal and newborn notes in their correct records
inputs: complete proposed maternal and newborn assessment notes
actual assessment findings and chosen follow-up
outputs: approved final maternal and newborn notes

steps.what: Save the approved maternal assessment note in the mother's clinical record
inputs: approved final maternal and newborn notes

steps.what: Save the approved newborn assessment note in the baby's clinical record
inputs: approved final maternal and newborn notes

tasks.design: Keep regular postpartum examinations and follow-up decisions with the midwife at {OTHER}, the care setting and clinical record. Try approved native note drafting from actual dictated findings, with separate patient attribution and final whole-note review before each record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: A scheduled assessment is not evidence that a mother or baby was examined or had a particular finding.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded documentation drafting can organise actual clinician-provided observations.
tasks.still_hard: Interpret postpartum changes and determine appropriate follow-up.
tasks.human_edge: Examine both patients and respond to their actual condition.

ambition.what: Support documentation without reducing assessment frequency or attention.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-6; verify approved clinical processing, linked-record access and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved clinical documentation tools can draft notes from clinician-provided actual observations for clinician verification.

assumptions: Existing care record supplies actual history, previous findings and schedule; s1 reads them and s2/s3 produce current actual findings. No scheduled or prior value substitutes for a current observation. s4 retains all clinical interpretation and follow-up choices.

s5 includes midwife dictation of actual patient ID, encounter/time, observations, units, reasoning, chosen follow-up and unresolved issues; retained 60% includes capture and correction. Missing findings stay blank and are entered manually. A maternal finding cannot populate the baby's note or vice versa.

Native templates and approved clinical drafting come first. Central reduces only typing-heavy narrative documentation and retains s6 full final verification. If current native notes already suffice or approved drafting is unavailable, no change is made. Clinical care and any subsequent referral/order sends are unchanged separate workflows.

s6 follows completed notes and binds each correct patient/version; edits invalidate the relevant approval. Same-system saves are approximately zero time and earn no saving. Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; incremental focal template/error upkeep=1; net=5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Actual narrative burden and linked-patient attribution error rate.
research_questions: Compare full postpartum documentation time including actual dictation, patient attribution checks and all corrections.

already_counted.description: Final maternal/newborn note verification retained at s6

incremental.description: Inspect note errors and maintain patient-specific approved fields

approvals.approved_version: complete final maternal assessment note bound to the mother's record
complete final newborn assessment note bound to the baby's record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native notes or access constraints make drafting unnecessary; high allows two extra hours correcting attribution or clinical meaning beyond central net 5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel women on pregnancy nutritional requirements

steps.what: Discuss the woman's actual dietary situation, concerns and relevant pregnancy context
inputs: woman's actual dietary account and concerns
existing relevant pregnancy record
outputs: understood nutritional counselling needs and constraints

steps.what: Find applicable approved pregnancy nutrition information for the counselling needs
inputs: understood nutritional counselling needs and constraints
existing approved pregnancy nutrition leaflet library

steps.what: Counsel the woman on pregnancy nutritional requirements in her actual circumstances
inputs: source-linked approved information options
understood nutritional counselling needs and constraints
outputs: delivered midwife-selected counselling and discussed options

steps.what: Check understanding, answer questions and agree practical next steps or further support
inputs: delivered midwife-selected counselling and discussed options
woman's actual questions and understanding
outputs: actual understanding, selected information and agreed next steps

steps.what: Prepare the selected approved nutrition leaflet links and agreed actions for the woman
inputs: actual understanding, selected information and agreed next steps
verified woman's contact and permitted delivery method

steps.what: Approve the final information message, selected leaflet versions and exact recipient
inputs: complete information message and recipient
actual agreed next steps and approved leaflet versions
outputs: approved final information message and recipient

steps.what: Send the approved nutrition information to the specified woman
inputs: approved final information message and recipient

steps.what: Record and confirm actual counselling topics, understanding and agreed next steps
inputs: actual understanding, selected information and agreed next steps
delivered midwife-selected counselling

steps.what: Save the confirmed counselling note in the same clinical record
inputs: confirmed final nutrition counselling note

tasks.design: Use native {DOCS} indexing to find approved information, while the midwife counsels at {OTHER}, the care setting. Populate a native {EMAIL} template with the midwife's selected leaflet links and actual agreed actions, approve the final message, and separately send it.
tasks.previous_blocker: A generic leaflet does not establish a woman's actual dietary needs or understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Approved-source indexing and message templates can support information access and delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Adapt counselling to the woman's situation and check understanding.
tasks.human_edge: Listen to concerns and agree feasible next steps.

ambition.what: Support existing counselling without generating personalised dietary advice automatically.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; verify approved materials, patient delivery permissions and consultation needs

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved patient-information libraries can be indexed and selected leaflet links can populate a reviewed message template.

assumptions: Approved library owner supplies leaflet ID, version, topic, language and source. Midwife selects suitable information from actual needs in s1-s4; missing or uncertain applicability stays manual. No model creates nutritional requirements or patient-specific recommendations.

s5 includes capturing selected leaflet IDs, actual agreed actions and verified recipient/delivery permission from the woman; retained 40% includes this entry and exceptions. s8 separately captures actual topics, understanding and next steps for the clinical record. No upstream structured counselling tags are assumed free.

Native library views and information templates come first. Central retains 70% of lookup and 40% of message preparation and removes only a real existing separate information send. Counselling, understanding checks and clinical note entry remain unchanged. If the native workflow already covers these actions, no change is made.

s6 approves the completed message and recipient before s7; changes void approval. s8 confirms the completed note before s9. Same-system save is approximately zero time and earns no saving. Provisional B=100, R=90.5, gross=9.5; incremental focal leaflet/template upkeep=1; net=8.5. Shares are illustrative and independent of means priors.
unknowns: Existing leaflet indexing and actual separate information-message work.
research_questions: Observe counselling through approved information delivery and time all actual selection, entry and review.

already_counted.description: Final patient information message review retained at s6

incremental.description: Check approved leaflet versions and message mappings

approvals.approved_version: complete final information message, leaflet versions and exact recipient
confirmed final actual nutrition counselling note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where native patient information delivery already suffices; high allows three extra hours locating suitable approved materials and correcting message fields beyond central net 8.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Midwives retain assessment, care and counselling decisions; approved documentation and information tools support specific record and delivery steps.
reach: Clinical documentation lead: learn approved note tools and patient attribution controls
skills_to_grow: Verify final notes and patient information recipients
role.ambitious_version: A midwife spends the required time with women and babies while maintaining checked, actual clinical records and approved information handoffs.
